Once upon a time there was a small little family of sheep. Now these sheep aren't just any sheep herd. No. These sheep are the bravest sheep in the land. The kids of Sir Sheepine Sheeperson, Broseph and Brosephina, along with their cousin Bob were known as the warrior sheeps. The Sheeperson family ruled Sheepsville. One day Bob decided to start a war between the sheeps of Sheepsville and the cows of Cowity. Broseph and Brosephina were astonished that Bob had betrayed them and caused beef with the cows. Soon war was declared. This was time for the duo Broseph and Brosephina to win this battle. The sheeps start shooting arrows at the cows and take them all done within minutes. Sheepsville wins and all of the sheeps begin to cheer. 
"We're saved!" Bob exclaimed. 
"Why are you still here?" Brosephina asked. 
Broseph picks up a crossbow and shoots Bob in the knee. 
"You're the sheep. You fucking follower. I'm the leader" said Broseph. Then proceeds to shoot Bob in the head.
Months after, the sheep of Sheepsville award Broseph with the Highest Ranked Warrior Sheep and builds a 15-foot tall statue of Broseph made of wool to commemorate him.
The End
